article.title: Kitchen Table Politics: What the 2026 Midterms Revealed About Abortion, Trans Dignity, and the Indignity of Common Sense
article.author: Ja'Loni Owens
article.content: We talk about "kitchen table politics" as if it were a place free of culture, a neutral ground of gas prices and grocery bills where the culture wars are an unwelcome distraction. Anyone who has actually sat at one knows better. The kitchen table is where the culture war is fought, and it is fought by people who love you. Read more via Scalawag : Kitchen Table Politics: What the 2026 Midterms Revealed About Abortion, Trans Dignity, and the Indignity of Common Sense .
